title: cotula minuta
intro: Cotula minuta, commonly known as Tanacetum miniatum or Microginosma minuta, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a small, annual herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cotula minuta include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its capacity to prevent the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Cotula minuta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
